units.source_text: 岛村下了火车，最先映入眼帘的便是这山上的白花。

en.t: After Shimamura got off the train, the first thing that caught his eye was the white flowers on the mountain.

units.source_text: 从陡削的山腰到山顶一带，遍地盛开着这种花，白花花地一片银色，好像倾泻在山上的秋阳一般。

en.t: From the steep mountainside up toward the summit, these flowers bloomed everywhere, a white spread of silver like autumn sunlight pouring down over the mountain.

units.source_text: 啊！岛村不由得动了感情，把漫山的白花当作是白胡枝子了。

en.t: Ah! Shimamura could not help being moved, and he took the white flowers covering the mountain for white bush clover.
